proposal_title: Event Envelope Standardization with OpenTelemetry Distributed Tracing & Topic Naming
domain_specific_rationale: For system reliability, debugging distributed cascades, and diagnosing asynchronous worker timeouts, standardized OpenTelemetry tracing headers (trace_id, span_id) and correlation identifiers (correlation_id, workflow_run_id) inside every event envelope are indispensable. Standardizing topic names with lowercase dotted syntax (^avf\.[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)+$) eliminates message routing ambiguities, dead letter confusion, and silent partition dropping across event brokers.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-04 (Event-Driven Integration) and CAP-14 (Platform Observability), ensuring end-to-end trace propagation across all 15 repositories.
residual_risk: Asynchronous event producers failing to propagate parent span context across process boundaries. Mitigated by R14 shared OpenTelemetry client interceptors enforcing automated context propagation.
